description: Paid: 0.005 RLUSD per call via x402 on XRPL mainnet (xrpl:0), or 0.005 USDC on Base (eip155:8453). Pay per call, solves one question: What does this AI provider's status page and our last 24h record show? Raw indicator, incidents, and disturbed-check share with sources and timestamps. Without payment this returns isError with the x402 PaymentRequired object (fresh invoiceId); retry with the signed payload in _meta["x402/payment"] or the payment_signature argument. Unpaid calls cost nothing.

payment_signature.description: Optional. Base64 x402 PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value (signed RLUSD or USDC PaymentPayload) for hosts that cannot set _meta["x402/payment"]. Omit on the first call to receive the payment requirements.

provider.description: Vendor slug (status feeds: anthropic, morph; others return unknown) or a model id like anthropic/claude-sonnet-4
